decisions.reason: The firm's accumulated sunk costs and public commitment to this second resin injection unit continue to favor persistence, making withdrawal unlikely.
As a central part of the announced application technology direction, the automatic gun justifies its launch investment and retains strong management commitment.
The manual airless spray gun benefits from established manufacturing and distribution commitments that escalation tendencies make hard to abandon quickly.
The multi-model product line is a highly visible and substantial commitment, so management will strongly persist with it.
